subject.title: [Feature]: feat: trigger session-memory hook on /compact command

question: Should bundled session-memory archive on `session:compact:before` for all compactions, only on manual `/compact`, or should memoryFlush/continuity remain the intended compaction-preservation path?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but the permanent behavior affects manual versus automatic compaction, transcript retention, lifecycle payload shape, and overlap with memoryFlush and continuity work.

options.title: Use Lifecycle Archive
options.body: Wire session-memory to `session:compact:before` with enough transcript/session context so manual and automatic compaction share one archive contract.

options.title: Manual Compact Only
options.body: Add a `/compact`-specific archive path if maintainers want user-invoked compaction to behave like `/new` and `/reset` without changing automatic compaction retention.

options.title: Keep MemoryFlush/Continuity
options.body: Leave session-memory scoped to `/new` and `/reset` and document memoryFlush or continuity snapshots as the supported compaction preservation mechanism.

recommendation.title: Use Lifecycle Archive
recommendation.body: Wire session-memory to `session:compact:before` with enough transcript/session context so manual and automatic compaction share one archive contract.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored the compaction lifecycle hook surface that is the likely owner boundary for the product contract choice.
